accepted_findings: FOUR_REQUIRED needs actual four physical devices and actual numerical-success capacity evidence
TerminateJobObject failure must still wait exact owned roots and preserve unknown cleanup
provider ROOT_STATIC_ADMISSION=True is not manager authority
trusted digest list alone does not bind summary fields to hashed artifact bytes
partial pipe and duplicate allocation leaks; reader handle ownership races; bad_read ignored

questionable_findings.adjudication: owned.append(rec) transfers exact handles to caller cleanup; local ph/th=None is not alone a leak. Suggested delayed transfer can cause local+caller double cleanup. Keep explicit single ownership and fix actual caller exception handling instead.

size_ceiling_note: Original and corrective coding size ceilings differ; line count compliance is separate from execution safety. Do not minify or remove safety checks to satisfy a line budget.
